paragraphs: A debate on India Today focuses on the shocking lapses and alleged cover-up in a high-profile Tamil Nadu POCSO investigation involving Veeramani. Political analyst Dr Sumanth C. Raman strongly argued that the state police cannot impartially investigate their own senior officials and urged the state government to transfer the probe to the Central Bureau of Investigation, noting: 'Clearly somebody wanted to cover it up... this case should be handed over to the CBI.' Meanwhile, TVK national spokesperson Felix Gerald asserted that the administration under Chief Minister Joseph Vijay maintains zero tolerance for crimes against women and children, assuring that no culprit or complicit official will escape accountability. Political analyst Harish Mohammed Ibrahim countered TVK's assertions by highlighting previous actions and questioning political double standards, sparking an intense clash during the broadcast over police closure reports, political interference, and judicial intervention by the POCSO court magistrate.

A political showdown erupted in the Karnataka Assembly between the Congress and the BJP over the rendition of Vande Mataram. When assembly proceedings commenced, the Congress government concluded the national song after two stanzas, opting for a shorter version. BJP legislators protested and continued singing the remaining verses inside the house. The BJP accused the ruling Congress of minority appeasement and insisted on playing the full version in accordance with central directives. Meanwhile, the Congress defended its stance by citing historical deliberations regarding the composition during the freedom movement.

A special POCSO court rejected an initial police closure report in a case involving influential granite baron Veeramani, directing a fresh investigation into the matter. The initial five-month police inquiry was closed citing a lack of evidence, failure to recover original footage, and the inability to identify the victim. Following the court's intervention, a renewed 40-day probe resulted in the arrest of the prominent businessman and two others. Questions have been raised regarding lapses in the preliminary investigation, with authorities confirming an inquiry into the actions of the earlier investigating police team.

Tensions between Iran and the United States continue to escalate in West Asia amid an ongoing deadlock. Iran issued a stern warning via state news agency IRNA, stating its readiness to launch an effective, continuous, and painful retaliation against US bases and regional allies if targeted by American military action. Meanwhile, the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked, and the US has asserted control over Iranian port access, intercepting over 109 merchant vessels. Following Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, US President Donald Trump indicated potential strikes against Iran. Washington has also advised its citizens against travelling to the region.
